feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 5 June 2026 9:54pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 05 June 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure to the southwest of the British Isles slowly tracking east and filling, frontal zone affects the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, backing east or southeast 5 to 7 overnight, decreasing 3 to 5 later tomorrow morning, becoming variable 2 to 4 for a time before settling west or southwest 4 to 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming moderate occasionally rough overnight then mainly slight later.


##Weather##

Rain or drizzle soon arriving, becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 to 6, soon backing south or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 6 or 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Isolated rain or drizzle soon becoming occasional.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
